component.name: unofficial tiptoi Manager for Linux
component.summary: Download tiptoi titles, browse the catalog and update your pen
tiptoi-Titel herunterladen, Katalog durchsuchen und den Stift aktualisieren

description.p: An unofficial, community-managed replacement for the Ravensburger tiptoi Manager, which only exists for Windows and macOS. It follows the look and everyday workflow of the original application: browse and search the live product catalog with covers and categories, download titles, copy them onto the pen with on-device verification, update outdated titles, install new pen firmware, and mount or unmount the pen safely.
This program is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ravensburger. tiptoi is a trademark of Ravensburger AG.
